posts.title: Adaptive disclosure cut my agent's tokens to a third — and my success metric was measuring the wrong thing
posts.summary: Adaptively sizing what a browser agent sees cut token cost to 0.32x on a weak model with no measurable loss in tasks completed. Getting to that claim meant throwing out a louder one: my success flag recorded whether the run finished, not whether the task was done.
